housing.summary: Numbeo reports EUR 450/month for a one-bedroom apartment in Le Havre city centre (last update 28 November 2025): https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Le-Havre-France. For an unfurnished principal-residence lease, the deposit is capped at one month of rent excluding charges; the furnished cap is two months: https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F31269. Current Le Havre rental listings are available on leboncoin: https://www.leboncoin.fr/cl/locations/cp_le%20havre_76600

banking.summary: Crédit Agricole says a newcomer generally provides a valid official photo ID, proof of address under three months old, and a signature specimen: https://www.credit-agricole.fr/particulier/conseils/magazine/tout-un-mag/tout-ce-qui-faut-savoir-pour-avoir-un-compte-bancaire.html. Crédit Agricole Normandie-Seine is confirmed on its official regional site: https://www.credit-agricole.fr/ca-normandie-seine/particulier.html. BNP Paribas is confirmed by its official Le Havre Président René Coty branch page: https://nos-agences.mabanque.bnpparibas/normandie/seine-maritime/le-havre/agence-le-havre-president-rene-coty-949
required_docs: Valid official photo ID (national identity card, passport, residence card or residence permit)
Proof of address less than three months old

schools.summary: Institution Saint-Joseph in Le Havre offers a British International Section: https://st-jo.fr/en/highschool/the-british-international-section/. Its current international section leads to the French Baccalaureate International (BFI): https://st-jo.fr/lycee/sections-internationales/. The Académie de Normandie school dataset is the official regional directory: https://data.normandie.education.gouv.fr/explore/dataset/etablissements/

legal_admin.summary: A holder of a visa de long séjour valant titre de séjour (VLS-TS) must validate it and pay the tax online within three months after arrival: https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F16162. The official Ministry of the Interior procedure is listed at https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/R52684
legal_admin.registration_step: If issued a VLS-TS, validate it online and pay the required tax within three months of arrival.

tax_finance.summary: A person without a French tax number obtains one after filing a first paper income-tax return with the required supporting documents; the tax administration then assigns the 13-digit numéro fiscal: https://www.impots.gouv.fr/particulier/questions/comment-creer-mon-espace-finances-publiques

transport.summary: Le Havre's public-transport network is LiA, whose standard all-public monthly pass costs EUR 45: https://www.transports-lia.fr/fr/trouver-mon-tarif. An EU/EEE licence remains usable while valid and exchange is required only in specified cases: https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F1758. A non-EU licence is generally valid for one year after normal residence begins and must be exchanged within that period to keep driving when exchange is available: https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F1460. For public healthcare, complete, sign and send form S1106a with situation-specific documents to the applicable CPAM or MSA: https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/R45084. The local CPAM office is confirmed at https://lannuaire.service-public.fr/normandie/seine-maritime/ab2fc83e-146a-4c68-8878-efca5d99f108
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEE licences may be used while valid and are exchanged only in specified cases. Non-EU licences are generally valid for one year from acquisition of normal residence; request exchange within that period when the issuing country is eligible, otherwise a French test is required to continue driving.
transport.healthcare_registration: Complete, print, sign and send form S1106a with the supporting documents required for the applicant's situation to the applicable local CPAM (or MSA for the agricultural regime).
